rule: Reviewed case specifications and exact authored fixture data only. No executable test or validator is added by LRA0. Existing evidence denotes inspected current controls, not a passing successor implementation; receiving owners execute cases under their own lanes. Fixture release identities come from exact captured profile selection, with real repository dependency/oracle pins preserved.

cases.name: Absent or inapplicable row
cases.input: Svelte profile only; demand a Vue-only rule, then disable an otherwise applicable row.
cases.required: Zero body calls, semantic demands, index walks, subprocess launches and rule-owned allocations; applicable neutral rows still run.
cases.forbidden: Post-emission filtering or hidden rule work.

cases.name: Same spelling, independent profile epochs
cases.input: Two exact profiles register rule x at epochs 1 and 2; reverse provider order.
cases.required: Distinct registration/diagnostic/cache keys; unchanged profile never sees the other epoch; canonical rows and output are equal across permutations.

cases.name: Stale and conflicting edits
cases.input: Plan at r1; edit a target at r2; separately compose two overlapping replacements and a stale member of a two-file alternative.
cases.required: Whole alternative rejected with exact cause; neither file modified; initial non-overlap controls remain applicable.
cases.forbidden: Partial apply, offset clamping, overlap text merge or relabelled basis.

cases.name: Truthful TypeInfo fact quality
cases.input: Rule requests a component facet; compare supported-empty, unsupported, NeedInputs and degraded facts.
cases.required: Preserve independent guarantees and cause; degraded answers never admitted as complete/warm; use the one ComponentInfo view.
cases.forbidden: Empty-success substitution or a rule-local component resolver.

cases.name: Diagnostic provenance and deterministic order
cases.input: Reverse registration/completion order, change display messages, include equal ranges in different profiles and native/external aliases.
cases.required: Canonical typed identity and order; one producing owner per concept; unchanged source/profile/epoch facts stay equal.
cases.forbidden: Message or hash iteration ordering; duplicate native/external diagnostic.

cases.name: Authored maps and source provenance
cases.input: Non-ASCII and CRLF preceding a virtual/template edit, then a non-reversible map and wrong map revision.
cases.required: Checked authored UTF-8 ranges retain source/map chain; transports convert without changing semantic identity; refusal leaves all files untouched.
cases.forbidden: Generated coordinate escape, byte/code-unit alias, string-search recovery.

cases.name: Applicability separate from safety
cases.input: Legacy Safe action inserting an empty expression; a pure formatting action; a behavior-changing URL suggestion.
cases.required: Placeholder remains has-placeholders, behavior change needs explicit selection, pure formatting uses formatter; no automatic grant from old safety.

cases.name: Complete overlay verification
cases.input: Alternative removes finding but deletes a used import; cancel checker; then omit an affected consumer.
cases.required: Maybe-incorrect names blocking/new diagnostic; base cache unchanged; complete safe control can earn machine applicability.

cases.name: Receipt dependency/population revalidation
cases.input: r1 receipt; r2 unrelated edit; then config change, rule epoch change, source/map edit or newly affected file.
cases.required: Unrelated read-set-valid edit mints a new qualified receipt and preserves r1; relevant changes require full reverification.
cases.forbidden: Cache keyed only by edit hash/base revision; original receipt relabelled.

cases.name: Edit/revert and cancellation
cases.input: Warm lint, edit a demanded dependency/config/suppression, compare fresh at each revision, revert; cancel mid-rule.
cases.required: Incremental equals fresh including exact provenance and order; cancelled/stale/partial results never warm.
cases.forbidden: Warm answer under obsolete epoch/config/membership or partial empty success.

cases.name: Suppression identity and consumption
cases.input: Two rules in the same range; suppress one alias under one profile; disable/enable, inactive service and missing authored geometry.
cases.required: Only the exact matching diagnostic is suppressed; enable caps range; inactive service does not report unused; missing geometry refuses.
cases.forbidden: Family-wide suppression, 500-byte guess or unused report without produced diagnostic.

cases.name: Representative Vue equivalence
cases.input: Authored FV01/FV02 plus their clean and wrong-profile controls.
cases.required: Diagnostic rule/range and provider edit bytes preserved on admitted native controls; profile/help/safety metadata qualified; only selected Vue adapters retired.
cases.forbidden: Missing fixture edit, false positive on clean binding or premature shared registry deletion.

cases.name: Representative Svelte adoption and retained neutral behavior
cases.input: Authored FS01/FS02; active Svelte, inactive Svelte, active Vue and dynamic URL controls.
cases.required: BlockLang behavior preserved; selected static URL body/provider adopted under exact Svelte identity; no Vue identity leakage; unsupported cells explicit; shared bodies remain.
cases.forbidden: Claiming a current Svelte unsafe-URL baseline, loss of neutral behavior or Vue-shaped global rule row.

cases.name: Shared initial-pack public cutover
cases.input: Initial pack fixtures through LSP, NAPI, WASM/FFI and MCP/scoring.
cases.required: Equivalent rule identity, severity, authored geometry, provenance and edit bytes on each surface; one shared service; zero legacy registry callers.
cases.forbidden: Terminal implementing pack defects, external auto-fix or LSP-only post-filter.

cases.name: Ownership inventory refusal
cases.input: Positive complete inventory; remove member, use unknown or pathless owner, conflict assignments, or nominate docs-only deletion owner.
cases.required: UAP0-AC-R1 rejects each invalid inventory while accepting the complete single-owner control.
cases.forbidden: Text-only blanket completeness assertion or accepting a non-production deletion owner.

cases.name: Neutral body and external boundary
cases.input: Same neutral facts under Vue/Svelte, conflicting external/native concept, untrusted external policy and WASM.
cases.required: Same common body without framework branches; one selected authority; denied external execution gives explicit unavailable/refused outcome.
cases.forbidden: Third-party code in core, silent fallback or duplicate fixes.

fixtures.note: Existing body requires dynamic is; provider byte parity is pinned, but empty expression is a placeholder and never machine-applicable. Ordinary div and wrong-profile controls stay quiet.

Provider fixture pins its supplied quoted-value diagnostic span, as existing provider tests do. This is not evidence that current rule-to-provider span composition is correct: the rule reports attr.span. The receiving pack must bind parsed attribute/value geometry and test the integrated route without deleting or blessing either semantic test.
Existing carrier-neutral block fact behavior; no current fix provider, so action applicability is none with a reason. Svelte identity and common-body ownership must remain distinct.

Selected new Svelte row adopts existing static URL body/provider behavior. No active Svelte-specific row exists at this head. Dynamic href={url} and inactive-profile controls stay quiet; pointer geometry is parser-owned, not recovered by scanning strings. Quote-preserving provider twins retain their own existing tests.
